message: Legacy AI provider environment variables are imported once and then ignored
bullet_points: Upgrading imports the `BASEROW_*` AI provider connection and model-list variables into **Admin → AI providers**, and each workspace's stored AI settings into that workspace. The imported provider then takes precedence, so editing those variables afterwards has no effect. Rotate credentials in the admin instead. Provider types with nothing configured in the admin still fall back to their environment settings.
Imported credentials are stored in the database, so they now appear in database dumps.

A workspace that had a credential but no model list now has no models available, where it previously fell back to the instance model list. A workspace that had models but no credential now uses the full instance model list instead of its own shorter one. Complete the configuration under workspace **Settings → AI providers** to restore the intended list.

A workspace with its own AI credential now uses the provider's default endpoint unless it sets its own. Previously it fell back to the instance's `BASEROW_OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `BASEROW_OPENAI_ORGANIZATION`. If a workspace must reach a specific endpoint, set it on that workspace's provider under **Settings → AI providers**.
Kuma's model is not imported. Mark a model as available for Kuma and select it under **AI features**; until then it keeps using its environment configuration.
